title: 700-Series Maintenance Mode Framework v1.0

rapid_pulse.frequency: Every 5 sessions or 3 hours of write activity

trigger_thresholds.dl008_reemergence_ge_1: CRITICAL — halt all writes, quarantine, emergency remediation
trigger_thresholds.governance_guard_failure: CRITICAL — halt all pack writes, diagnose rule violation
trigger_thresholds.pack_parse_not_500: CRITICAL — halt pack-write agents, structural repair

escalation_conditions: New defect class (severity ≥ HIGH) → DEFECT_LIBRARY.md assignment
Answer-key integrity violation → TIER 1 answer-key audit
maintenance_agent_types: Governance Auditor — T0 entry protocol, hash verification, count stability (read-only)
Reconciliation Agent — G1-G5 gates (read-only, reports drift)
Defect Sweeper — DL-008/026/013/031 scans (read-only, flags findings)
Baseline Maintainer — CURRENT_BASELINES.md refresh (write, backup required)
Delivery Safety Inspector — Pre-delivery certified-only pool check (read-only)
Remediation Agent — Pack-file fixes (write, BLOCK-AUTHORIZED, ≤30 items/batch)
